title: The Chaldæan Oracles of Zoroaster
subtitle: Edited and Revised by Sapere Aude, with an Introduction by L. O.
author: Collectanea Hermetica, Volume VI
imprint: Collectanea Hermetica, edited by W. Wynn Westcott, Volume VI. London: Theosophical Publishing Society, 1895
note: The edition the School of Ageless Wisdom's lessons quote ("Volume 6 of the Collectanea Hermetica"): Sapere Aude is W. Wynn Westcott, L. O. Percy Bullock. Set from the sacred-texts.com transcription of the 1895 printing, read word by word and mark by mark against the scan of it at IAPSOP. The transcription's slips are corrected; the print's own misprints are kept. The three schemes of the Introduction (pp. 9–11) are set as tables from the page.
